latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—introduces automated architecture governance skill.

- Enables users to design fitness functions to enforce and measure architecture characteristics (e.g., modularity, scalability, maintainability) over time.
- Supports governance for a range of concerns: structure (layer dependencies, code complexity), compliance, architecture erosion, and CI/CD integration.
- Provides input gathering and default rules for cases with incomplete context, ensuring useful output even with limited information.
- Integrates with related skills to identify architecture characteristics and evaluate modularity health.
- Suitable for use with or without an existing CI/CD pipeline and supports multiple technology stacks.
- Offers guidance and tool recommendations for structural tests, chaos engineering, and architecture compliance testing.
